	<p><span style="font-weight: 400">We have over 100 workspaces at our Bow Road site, which is only a stone’s throw from our well-loved Nunnery Gallery and Café. The artists here say they love its strong creative atmosphere, as well as meeting and sharing their work with a diverse and inspiring group of people. The site hosts a variety of semi-open plan spaces of varying sizes, suitable for a wide range of different practices.</span></p>

<p>Bow Road Studios, 181-183 Bow Road, London, E3 2SJ</p>
<p>Nearest train station(s): Bow Church (DLR), Bow Road Tube Station (District, Hammersmith and City)</p>
<p>Bus: 8, 25, 108, 205, 276, 425, 288, D8, N205</p>
<p>Parking: Resident parking can be found after 5pm Monday-Friday, free parking is available on the weekends</p>
